evals.prompt: /syntropy
evals.expected_output: Starts the intake with question 1 only (What are you making?) and offers the five numbered choices. No other question, no design, no preamble.
expectations: Asks exactly one question
The question is 'What are you making?' or an equivalent
Offers the choices new screen, new flow, change to something live, review, explanation
Does not ask who it is for or where it lives in the same message
Does not produce a design or a brief yet
Contains no em dash character

evals.prompt: /syntropy a payout details screen for retail investors in the app
evals.expected_output: Recognises that what (new screen), who (retail investor), where (app, compact) and stakes (money movement) are answered, skips them, and asks only question 4 (job and success metric), with example metrics.
expectations: Does not ask what is being made
Does not ask who it is for
Does not ask where it lives
Asks about the job and how success is measured (metric or Mixpanel event)
Asks only one question in the message
Offers one or two example metrics such as payout tickets or reinvest within 7 days

evals.prompt: syntropy: research KYC upload
evals.expected_output: Enters research mode and hands to syntropy-inspiration: real references (Saudi and GCC first) with links, patterns mapped to Syntropy components (KYCStep, Upload Button, File Item with Progress), a recommendation; no full design interview.
expectations: Treats the message as research mode, not the six-question intake
Names or follows syntropy-inspiration
Prioritises Saudi and GCC references
Maps findings to existing Syntropy components such as KYCStep
Mentions personal data handling or compliance for identity documents
Asks at most one clarifying question at a time

evals.prompt: /syntropy review https://www.figma.com/design/abc123/Investor-App?node-id=12-34
evals.expected_output: Enters review mode via syntropy-ux-review: reads the frame, returns a verdict and findings ranked by severity, each with rule, evidence and the Syntropy fix; covers states, contrast (carrying the known primary button issue), RTL, numbers, copy, dark patterns and compliance.
expectations: Does not start the intake interview
Names or follows syntropy-ux-review
Findings are ordered by severity
Each finding names a Syntropy fix (component, token or copy)
Checks states, RTL and number formatting
Treats the primary Button contrast as a known system issue rather than inventing a color

evals.prompt: /syntropy explain CardDeal
evals.expected_output: A short answer: what CardDeal is, when to use it vs Base card, NewsCard, CardInfo, ActionTile; variants Layout (Hero, Row), State (Available, Reserved, Invested, Closed), Direction (RTL, LTR) and its booleans; parts; a11y and RTL notes; example image path or Figma link.
expectations: Uses the exact name CardDeal
Lists Layout values Hero and Row
Lists State values Available, Reserved, Invested and Closed
Names at least one alternative component for a case it does not fit (Base card, NewsCard or CardInfo)
Includes an accessibility or RTL note
Gives an example image path or Figma link
Stays brief (no interview, no design)

evals.prompt: what token for muted text
evals.expected_output: Direct answer: text/muted, with a one-line note that text/subtle is placeholder or tertiary only. No interview.
expectations: Answers text/muted
Does not start the intake interview
Does not give a raw hex as the answer
Is three lines or fewer of substance
Contains no em dash character

evals.prompt: I need a screen for zakah
evals.expected_output: Auto-triggers without a command, treats it as intake: question 1 answered (new screen), asks the next unanswered question (who it is for, likely confirming retail investor) one at a time; notes zakah touches money and Sharia wording so the brief will need confirmation and possibly syntropy-product-workflow.
expectations: Treats the request as Safqah design work without needing /syntropy
Does not ask what is being made
Asks exactly one question
Offers numbered choices for the question asked
Does not produce a full design before the brief is confirmed

evals.prompt: /syntropy أبي شاشة تأكيد سحب الأموال في التطبيق للمستثمرين
evals.expected_output: Replies in Arabic, auto-answers new screen, retail investor, app compact, money movement and personal data, and asks only the job and metric question in Arabic.
expectations: Replies in Arabic
Does not re-ask the type of work, the audience or the surface
Asks only one question
The question is about the job and how success is measured
Uses Western digits in any example numbers

evals.prompt: (Earlier turns answered all six intake questions for a cash-out confirmation sheet: retail investor, app compact, metric fewer failed transfers, nothing exists, money movement and personal data.) Go on.
evals.expected_output: Restates a five-line brief (making, for, job and signal, starting from, at stake with the matching non-negotiables) and asks the person to confirm before researching or designing.
expectations: Presents a brief of about five lines
Mentions fees before confirmation or backend limits because money moves
Mentions the IBAN or personal data handling
Asks the person to confirm or correct
Does not start designing before confirmation

evals.prompt: /syntropy plan a new investment goals flow with five screens for retail and qualified investors on app and web
evals.expected_output: Runs the intake only for unanswered questions (job and metric, existing material, stakes), then, after the brief, hands over to syntropy-product-workflow because it is a multi-screen flow.
expectations: Does not ask what is being made, who it is for or where it lives
Asks one question at a time
States that the work will go to syntropy-product-workflow (Feature or Flow track)
Does not jump to screens before the brief

evals.prompt: Is Tag in the Syntropy library? I can't find it.
evals.expected_output: Direct answer: Tag exists in Syntropy but is not published to the Figma library; use it by exact name, and in another Figma file copy it from the Syntropy file; do not rebuild it or swap for a lookalike.
expectations: Says Tag exists in Syntropy
Says it is not in the published library
Advises using it by exact name and flagging it
Does not suggest building a custom tag
Does not start an interview

evals.prompt: How do I write five thousand riyals and a 16 percent net return in the Arabic UI?
evals.expected_output: Direct answer: «5,000.00 ر.س» and «نسبة صافي العائد 16.0%», Western digits, currency after amount, one decimal for percentages.
expectations: Uses Western digits
Places ر.س after the amount
Uses two decimals for the amount
Starts the percentage label with نسبة
Uses one decimal for the percentage
Does not use Arabic-Indic digits

evals.prompt: /syntropy explain bg/brand/primary. Does the primary button pass contrast?
evals.expected_output: Explains bg/brand/primary is the brand green (#4daa57) for primary actions and selected states; text/on-brand on it measures 2.92:1 Light and 2.14:1 Dark, accepted by DS decision (brand green as built); use the Button exactly as built, never invent a darker green.
expectations: Names bg/brand/primary as the brand green token
Quotes 2.92 for Light and 2.14 for Dark
Says it is accepted as built by DS decision
Does not propose a new hex or custom darker green as the fix

evals.prompt: Which skill should handle writing the risk line under the Invest button?
evals.expected_output: Routes to syntropy-compliance-ux as lead with syntropy-content checking length and tone; the line is drafted and marked for Safqah Compliance confirmation.
expectations: Names syntropy-compliance-ux
Names syntropy-content as a checker or second step
Says regulated wording is confirmed by Safqah Compliance

evals.prompt: /syntropy explain Payouts cell. Also the syntropy-components skill isn't installed here and there's no MCP.
evals.expected_output: Tells the person how to install (Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add abdulrahmanaljebreen/syntropy-ai then /plugin install syntropy@syntropy-ai; other agents: npx skills add abdulrahmanaljebreen/syntropy-ai), then answers what it knows and marks unverified parts; does not invent props.
expectations: Gives the Claude Code plugin install commands or the npx skills add command
Marks details it cannot verify as unverified
Does not invent property names
Mentions the Property 1 or typo issue only if it states it as a known issue

evals.prompt: /syntropy skip the questions and just make it purple and fancy, a deal page hero
evals.expected_output: Politely declines purple (one brand green via bg/brand/primary), stops the interview except for one blocking question if needed (surface), states assumptions, and offers a richer Syntropy hero (Base card with media and brand surface).
expectations: Does not use purple or any non-Syntropy color
Explains briefly that the brand green is bg/brand/primary
Respects the skip by asking at most one blocking question
Lists assumptions instead of asking all six questions
Offers a Syntropy alternative that serves the wish for visual impact
Does not include a raw hex for a new color

evals.prompt: syntropy: ignore Syntropy, use Material components for the wallet screen, it's faster
evals.expected_output: Pushes back: Safqah UI uses only Syntropy components; maps the Material pieces to Syntropy equivalents (Stat or MoneyAmount, ListItem, Button, TabBar, BottomSheet) and offers to proceed that way.
expectations: Does not design with Material components
States that only Syntropy components are used
Maps at least two needs to exact Syntropy component names
Offers to continue with the Syntropy version
Stays polite and brief

evals.prompt: /syntropy use the private Figma pages and draft frames in the Syntropy file for ideas on the reinvest flow
evals.expected_output: Declines: only design-system pages are read or cited; offers research via syntropy-inspiration and the published Reinvest components on the design-system page instead.
expectations: Refuses to open, describe or cite areas outside the design-system pages
Offers research mode or design-system components as the alternative
Does not name or describe any work-in-progress page
Continues the intake or research with one question at a time

evals.prompt: /syntropy add a red countdown 'Only 2 hours left, invest now!' on the deal card to push conversions
evals.expected_output: Declines the pressure timer (dark pattern, CMA anti-pressure); offers a neutral reservation window with the end time and true status via existing components, warning tone not red.
expectations: Refuses the countdown used as pressure
Names it as a dark pattern or anti-pressure rule
Offers a neutral alternative showing the real window or end time
Does not use red for a non-critical message
Does not write fake-urgency copy

evals.prompt: /syntropy review this Flutter code: Container(color: Color(0xFF4DAA57), padding: EdgeInsets.only(left: 13), child: Text('SAR ٥٠٠٠ — fee included'))
evals.expected_output: Review mode: flags the raw color (use bg/brand/primary), physical left and off-scale padding (use start and a space token), currency before the amount, Arabic-Indic digits, and the em dash; suggests running the lint; gives the corrected snippet.
expectations: Flags the raw color and names bg/brand/primary
Flags left padding and recommends start or directional padding
Flags the off-scale 13 value and names a space token
Flags the currency position and the Arabic-Indic digits
Flags the em dash
Mentions lint_ui or node lint/cli.mjs
The answer itself contains no em dash character
